title: Artikuleet doorimte tiya
intro: qaleeli silaalak qibaadah qangor obte, ummatta imaan dahab ifuh gubat yengeyyeh. inki rooci, acwa lih yabti, sooleh qokol kaxxa farmo, uxih foocal uddur adda xer gibbatu. doorimte farmoyti diini xaganal tawqe wak, ta muuci darrel raaqeh, rabbo sinni agattiinah xaaqimeh. iyyaay ta digga le roociy xongolo kak ugteh sanama tacbadinih saduh?
clues: Anu Yalli nabiyyi akkuh doorem, takkay immay yi aydaadi mango uddur gersi marih xaqut warse.
Anu qanxaffe le mirac fan ruube, takkay immay yi doori qokolak sugte, miraaciinu hinna.
Anu acwa eloquence luk sugeeh, yi qangor sorkocobaxitte sahhalossuh yaanama.
Yi wakliiti diini xaganah gexe wak, anu rabbo sinni mara miraacisuh raqeh suge.
ken sabri sinnat, oson muuci bicsen sinni bilqak, kee anu ken xaaqimeh Yallal numma luk yaniinim.
Yi wakliiti yuduureh yoo yibbixe, laakin anu ummatta yoo yeyyeeqeh, yoo qiddam faxxam baxxaqise; Anu qellat abe marih fanat masugiyyo.
arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
